test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:

1. Peer evaluation is the most common method in this system.

2. Academic credibility is maintained through structured review mechanisms.

3. The aim is to verify research accuracy before publication.

4. This process ensures reliable scholarly communication.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph is structured logically to explain the peer evaluation process in an academic context.
 
• **Sentence 2 is the first sentence** as it introduces the structured review mechanisms:
 
 
• "Academic credibility is maintained through structured review mechanisms."</
